title: Gremlin
definition: The CADMIES designation for rented GPU instances used for fine-tuning and heavy computation.

difficulty_levels.beginner: A temporary, rented computer used for complex AI computations.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: A specific category of cloud-based computing resources that are leased out for AI model training and fine-tuning.
difficulty_levels.expert: A metaphorical representation of the transient and often problematic nature of large-scale AI computation, which relies on temporary, rented hardware to deliver results.

extra_fields.insight: The temporary, yet essential, nature of external resources in the pursuit of AI advancement.
